entries.title: Naval Aircraft Factory PBN-1 Nomad — source-based profile
entries.configuration: PBN-1 Nomad flying boat supplied to Soviet naval aviation: long pointed bow, extended afterbody, enlarged tall fin, two R-1830 radial tractor engines, parasol wing and waist blisters. In-flight profile with tip floats folded into the wingtips and no wheeled undercarriage. This is an independent Nomad profile, not an unchanged PBY-5 or amphibious PBY-5A drawing. Minor armament and equipment details simplified.

review.notes: Visually inspected at300px and900px against cited type-specific references. Full propellers, wings, tall or divided tail, hull or wheeled gear, and all tips fit inside white canvas. Exact physical engine count is represented by station groups; opposite stations overlap in profile. Checked the Nomad extended bow and afterbody, aft second step, large fin and absence of amphibious wheels against NACA PBN-1 Model192 and Soviet-delivery reference; added service waist blister using period reference. Retracted tip floats are shown in wing profile. Minor contours, panel lines and gun details remain simplified original illustration choices; no unseen views or engineering precision asserted.

entries.title: Sikorsky Ilya Muromets G-3 Renobalt — source-based profile
entries.configuration: Ilya Muromets G-3 Renobalt bomber configuration used as the explicit late-family reference: four wing-mounted inline tractor engines (two Renault and two RBVZ-6), unequal biplane wings, glazed cabin, overhead fuel tanks, two outboard rudders, central upper/lower fins and tail gun position. Fixed wheels, protective runners and tail skid. Port profile; opposite engine and rudder stations overlap. The game’s generic family entry does not assert this exact variant performance or internal seating.
